# DEPRECATION NOTICE

This project has been deprecated in favor of [github-telemetry-go](https://github.com/github/github-telemetry-go). Please migrate projects to `github-telemetry-go` going forward.

# go-kvp [![GoDoc](https://pkg.go.dev/badge/github.com/github/docs)](https://gopkgs.githubapp.com/github.com/github/go-kvp)
Key-value pairs for logging, tracing, reporting, etc.

Please head over to the [docs on how we manage contributions with go modules](https://github.com/github/go/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Want to file an issue?

Please head over to the [github.com/github/go](https://github.com/github/go/issues) repository. The frameworks-containers team owns many libraries, and keeping issues filed in one place helps us track and prioritize them accordingly. Thank you!
